cues: Rigid labeled structure: numbered sections for classification/constraints, dependencies, key decisions, first end-to-end slice (Phase 0), phases, validation checks, cross-cutting concerns, AI layer, Exceptions, Deferred
Budget table uses explicit tags (REQUIREMENT / ASSUMPTION / UNKNOWN / BASELINE) and names which check or phase verifies each one
Key decisions table with reversibility ratings (R2/R3), default, assumption, validated-by, and revisit trigger columns
Validation checks V0–V6 each have hypothesis, method, acceptance threshold, evidence, 'unlocks and if it fails' and phase; Phase 0 is a thin end-to-end slice through all tiers
Explicit '9. Exceptions: None', a 'Deferred' list with pull-forward triggers, an 'N/A' line for migration, and an AI-layer sublayer table with a build phase for each
